root: ^"It seems like you both have very different perspectives on your relationship, but it’s clear there’s love here, even amidst the tension.”
^“Rocky, you’re under a lot of pressure from your family, trying to provide for your community, and balancing that with your feelings for Peggy.”

^"Peggy, you’re feeling neglected, not just by Rocky’s absence but by the differences in your worlds. You come from a life of privilege, and it’s hard for you to reconcile that with the life Rocky is leading."
^"But that doesn’t mean your struggles aren’t real. You’ve had to adjust to a world that doesn’t always feel safe for you. That’s a heavy thing to carry, isn’t it?"
^"Yeah… I mean, where I live, I have to be careful all the time. Dodging people, watching for stray dogs, making sure I’m not caught somewhere I can’t fly out of."
^"It’s exhausting. I’m always looking over my shoulder, always trying to figure out if I’m about to be someone’s problem just because I exist in their space."
^"So… when you say I was never there with you… you don’t just mean you wanted company all of the time."
^"You wanted me there to protect you… because you felt scared."
^"I didn’t always feel safe. And I don’t think I wanted to admit that."
^"I thought providing for you meant… making sure you had food, a place to rest, things you needed. I thought that was enough."
^"I don’t want you to feel like that. Like you’re alone in it."
^"You say that, but you disappear for six hours."
^"You really don't like being wrong, do you?"
^"Just because it's free, that doesn't mean it's good."
^"You carry extra food in case I show up."
^"Food tastes better when you’re judging it. Places feel better when you approve of them. When something’s off you catch it before I do."
^"You fix things. You move fast. Nothing scares you."
^"And you're loyal. You take care of everyone. Your family, your people... even me."
^"And you just do it. You don't complain about it."
^"It's unintentional. You say things like they're completely normal, and they're not."
^"So I'm competent, loyal, and accidentally funny."
^"And it makes me feel safe. Like... I don't have to think about everything all the time."
^"That's why you're together. You don't just like each other. You rely on each other."
^"Right now, you understand each other in theory."
^"Peggy, you know Rocky will show up. Rocky, you know Peggy notices things you miss."
^"But you don't always feel that when it matters."
^"So what? Just trust each other more?"
^"It's less about saying it and more about experiencing it."
^"Sometimes, it helps to put yourselves in a situation where you have to rely on each other in real time."
^"For example: rock climbing. It's an activity where one person is climbing and the other person is responsible for supporting them."
^"One person has to manage the rope and guide the other through communication. They would be relying on you completely."
^"That's the feeling you want to build on."
^"Are you willing to give it a try?"
